main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean drift-adjusted 1-bar short gain on forecast<0 bars
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirm, t <= -2 reject, over at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: deeper-half minus shallower-half drift-adjusted next-day return <= 0

decided_by: Weighted mean gain t >= 2 over at least 100 cases and the deeper half's drift-adjusted return is not above the shallower half's.
reading: Situation from prices: up close after a down close, falling = 60-bar close change (percent) below -10, with run_depth raw > 0 and a non-chop regime used only where the window lacks the price lookback; t is the weighted mean over a day-clustered standard error (weighted deviations summed per day); halves split at the median |forecast| (deeper strictly above), compared by unweighted mean drift-adjusted next-day return.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.004196 on the check folds against +0.008923 on every fold
